notes: Reads fixed-width Finn.no housing-listing extracts (originally INFILE '/finn_data/g&ar&m0&mnd/grunnlag.txt' MISSOVER PAD LRECL=407, generated by a %finndata macro looping 2005-2014) and exports one year's stacked listings to Stata. Substituted a 3-row inline DATALINES block matching the exact 42-field @col layout (same LRECL=407, same informats) for one month's external file; the full LABEL block (kept in Norwegian, as in the original), the duplicate-listing sort/retain block, and PROC EXPORT DBMS=STATA are unchanged from upstream. Noted but preserved faithfully: the dedup counter block sets `antsalg=0` on a new BY group but increments a *different* variable, `ants` (never itself initialized), so `ants` stays missing throughout -- this looks like a variable-name typo in the original author's script (antsalg vs ants), not a Jenner defect; SAS's missing+1=missing propagation is documented behavior and Jenner reproduces it correctly.
